verdict.rationale: Riveter is a scraping and enrichment API, so scripting page interactions before content is returned is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows a scrape endpoint that turns a URL into parseable text, plus AI agents that interpret pages. Nothing documents scriptable clicking, filling inputs, or scrolling actions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can script page interactions like clicking, filling inputs, and scrolling before content is returned
